_comment: Curated in-app documentation (BRD gap Phase 4, ADR-072). `source` is relative to the repo's docs/ folder; each is copied to src/content/docs/<id>.md by `npm run docs:sync`. `audience`: everyone = any signed-in user, admin-manager = Admin and Manager only. Never add files containing credentials, keys or internal hostnames - docsContent.test.ts scans for the obvious ones.
